professional.name: RCTI+ Streaming Platform
professional.description: Indonesia's major streaming & entertainment platform under MNC Group, serving millions of daily users.
professional.longDescription: RCTI+ is one of Indonesia's largest digital entertainment platforms under MNC Group. As a Software Engineer, I work cross-functionally with Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams to ship world-class features at scale. The platform serves millions of daily active users with live streaming, video-on-demand, news, and interactive content.
responsibilities: Ship world-class products cross-functionally with Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams
Write clear, concise, performant, and well-tested code
Partner with product management to execute the feature roadmap
Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack
Optimize application performance for millions of concurrent users
Implement new features using PHP, Golang, Node.js, and Next.js

professional.name: Avarik Saga Universe
professional.description: Web3 blockchain game built on Unity with Solidity smart contracts powering the in-game economy and NFT marketplace.
professional.longDescription: Avarik Saga Universe is a blockchain-based gaming platform built on the Unity engine. I was responsible for developing the Solidity smart contracts that power the entire in-game economy — from NFT minting and trading to token rewards. The project required deep integration between on-chain logic and off-chain game mechanics.
responsibilities: Develop smart contracts using Solidity (ERC721, ERC20 standards)
Integrate smart contracts with Unity-based web3 game
Build decentralized applications using React.js, Web3.js, and Ethers.js
Optimize smart contract operations for minimal latency and gas cost
Collaborate with product managers, UX/frontend developers, and backend engineers
Create immersive and user-friendly experiences in decentralized applications

Optimize smart contract operations for minimal latency and computational cost
Build decentralized applications using React.js, Hardhat, Truffle, and Ethers.js
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet feature rollout timelines
Implement token economics and DeFi mechanisms

freelance.name: Civil Registration System
freelance.description: Government information system for Population & Civil Registration Agency serving 2 cities.
freelance.longDescription: A comprehensive information system designed for the Population and Civil Registration Agency (Disdukcapil). The system digitizes and streamlines document services including KTP (National ID), KIA (Child ID), and Family Card processing for the cities of Tebing Tinggi and Padangsidimpuan. This project is part of the Digital Of Thinking initiative I founded.
responsibilities: Design and architect the full system from requirements to deployment
Develop document services for KTP, KIA, and Family Card processing
Implement user management and role-based access control
Build reporting and analytics dashboards for government officials
Deploy and maintain the system for Tebing Tinggi City and Padangsidimpuan City
Provide training and support to government staff

responsibilities: Design and develop accounting and finance system modules
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into system design
Implement efficient data management and reporting functionalities
Ensure adherence to accounting principles and regulatory requirements
Conduct regular system maintenance and troubleshooting
Collaborate with end-users to identify areas for improvement

It was designed to integrate seamlessly with existing processes and data sources, ensuring smooth operations and data accuracy across all departments.
responsibilities: Design and develop comprehensive finance and accounting modules
Build warehouse management and budgeting systems
Integrate with existing processes and data sources
Ensure data accuracy and smooth cross-department operations
Provide training and support during implementation
Collaborate closely with the PDAM Tirtanadi team on requirements
